num_patients: <int> Total number of patients requiring surgical scheduling.
num_surgeons: <int> Total number of surgeons available across all hospitals.
num_hospitals: <int> Total number of hospitals in the coalition.
ORs_per_hospital: <int> Number of operating rooms in each hospital.
num_days: <int> Number of days in the planning horizon.
alpha: <float> Schedule tightness parameter controlling how surgeon workload is measured, where 0 counts full OR-occupation time and 1 counts only surgical procedure time.

patients.due_date: <int> Latest day by which this patient must be scheduled, where values within the planning horizon indicate a mandatory patient and values beyond indicate an optional patient.
patients.is_mandatory: <bool> Whether this patient must be scheduled within the planning horizon.
patients.preparation_time: <float> Pre-incision setup time in minutes required before the surgeon begins operating on this patient.
patients.cleaning_time: <float> OR turnover time in minutes required after this patient's surgery is completed.
patients.base_surgical_time: <float> Baseline surgical procedure duration in minutes before surgeon-specific adjustment.
patients.eligible_surgeons: <list[int], length varies> Surgeons qualified to operate on this patient.

eligible_ORs_by_hospital.{hospital_id}: <list[int], length varies> Operating rooms at this hospital where this patient can be scheduled.

surgeon_specific_times.{surgeon_id}: <float> Surgical procedure duration in minutes when this specific surgeon operates on this patient.

patients.reward: <float> Benefit earned for scheduling this optional patient within the current planning horizon, or 0 for mandatory patients.

availability_by_day.{day}: <int> Maximum number of minutes this surgeon is available to operate on this day.

surgeons.operating_days: <list[int], length varies> Days within the planning horizon on which this surgeon is available to operate.

ORs.or_id: <int> Unique identifier for this operating room within its hospital.
ORs.regular_time: <int> Default regular session time in minutes for this operating room.
ORs.max_overtime: <int> Default maximum allowable overtime in minutes for this operating room.
ORs.fixed_cost_per_hour: <float> Hourly cost incurred when this operating room is opened for a day.
ORs.overtime_cost_per_hour: <float> Hourly cost charged for each hour of overtime used in this operating room.

{day}.regular_time: <int> Regular session time in minutes for this operating room on this day.
{day}.max_overtime: <int> Maximum allowable overtime in minutes for this operating room on this day.

surgeon_fixed_costs_per_day.{surgeon_id}: <float> Fixed cost incurred when this surgeon is assigned to operate at this hospital on any given day.
